name: Interiors & More Ltd
about: Incorporated in June 2012, Interiors & More Limited trades, imports, and sells artificial flowers. The company manufactures and trades quality artificial flowers, plants, and decor items for homes and offices.[1]
keyPoints: Product Portfolio[1] The company offers various products, including artificial flowers such as Roses, Yellow Marigolds, Green Grass in Mats, green Leaves, carnations, Hydrangea, and Hanging orchids. Company trades in Fountains, battery-operated Candles, Chandeliers, vases made of Wood and Glass, artificial trees, Furniture, and Tables.

cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.72%
